m13.text: Sentos sat alone in a monk's cottage holding a flask of poison and the ring from the day he ended the war on Fleet Rock, resolving to drink to oblivion.

A woman held a blade to his throat, demanded to know whether he was Sentos the Merciful, and made him recount what happened on Fleet Rock, where he lied that he had spared the false king out of mercy.
She revealed herself as a gorgon of Xathrid, and although Sentos stabbed her in the heart with a shard of glass, she cut off his finger and took the ring, which grants ceaseless life.
Without the ring the venom killed Sentos, and he looked the gorgon in the face and was turned to stone.
